notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}
Cast Hypervolt Grasp by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Hypervolt Grasp spell.
Activate Hypervolt Grasp by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
